entries.label: Strength
entries.text: Every point in Strength increases your Attack Damage by 1%.

entries.label: Dexterity
entries.text: Every point in Dexterity increases your Attack Rating by 8 and your Critical Damage by 0.125%.

entries.label: Intelligence
entries.text: Every point in Intelligence increases Magic Skill Damage dealt.

entries.label: Energy
entries.text: Every point in Energy increases your Mana by 4. Mana gained from Energy also increases your base Mana Replenish.

entries.label: Armor
entries.text: Every point in Armor increases your Defense by 5.

entries.label: Vitality
entries.text: Every point in Vitality increases your Life by 5. Life gained from Vitality also increases your base Life Replenish.

entries.label: Points Left
entries.text: Points left to allocate into any of the primary stats. You can allocate 4 points by pressing [input_attribute_add_multi].

entries.label: Damage
entries.text: The amount of damage your attacks deal.

entries.label: Attacks per Second
entries.text: Amount of attacks performed in a second.

entries.label: Attack Speed
entries.text: Amount of increased Attack Speed. Percentual Attack Speed is always calculated using 0.75 Attacks Per Second.

entries.label: Attack Rating
entries.text: Increases your chance of hitting enemies with attacks.

entries.label: Chance for Critical Strike
entries.text: Chance for a Critical Strike when striking. Only affects physical attacks.

entries.label: Critical Strike Damage
entries.text: Amount of your Critical Strike damage. Only affects physical attacks.

entries.label: Flat Physical Damage
entries.text: Physical Damage added to your attacks.

entries.label: Magic Skill Damage
entries.text: Increases the damage of your Skills excluding skills which deal Attack Damage. This stat is calculated on top of the final value.

entries.label: Faster Cast Rate
entries.text: Increases your Casting speed. Faster Cast Rate is always calculated using 1 Cast Per Second.

entries.label: Deadly Blow
entries.text: Deadly Blow increases your Physical Damage by 35%

entries.label: Crushing Blow
entries.text: Crushing Blow breaks enemy armor by 10% stacking up to 5 times increasing physical damage taken by enemies.

entries.label: Open Wounds
entries.text: Open Wounds bleeds target enemy for 20% of your Physical Damage.

entries.label: Ignore Target Defense
entries.text: Ignores enemy Defense rating making it easier to hit the target.

entries.label: Slow Target
entries.text: Attacks slow enemy Movement and Attack Speed.

entries.label: Points in strength added as damage to charge skills
entries.text: A portion of your strength is added as damage for charge skills.

entries.label: Increased damage while unarmed
entries.text: Amount of damage increased while unarmed.

entries.label: Points in strength added as weapon damage while unarmed
entries.text: A portion of your strength is added as flat physical damage while unarmed.

entries.label: to All Skills
entries.text: Increases the level of all Skills.

entries.label: Physical Skills
entries.text: Increases the level of all Physical Skills.

entries.label: Cold Skills
entries.text: Increases the level of all Cold Skills.

entries.label: Fire Skills
entries.text: Increases the level of all Fire Skills.

entries.label: Lightning Skills
entries.text: Increases the level of all Lightning Skills.

entries.label: to Arcane Skills
entries.text: Increases the level of all Arcane Skills.

entries.label: Poison Skills
entries.text: Increases the level of all Poison Skills.

entries.label: Additive Cold Damage
entries.text: Cold Damage added to your attacks.

entries.label: Additive Fire Damage
entries.text: Fire Damage added to your attacks.

entries.label: Additive Lightning Damage
entries.text: Lightning Damage added to your attacks.

entries.label: Additive Arcane Damage
entries.text: Arcane Damage added to your attacks.

entries.label: Additive Poison Damage
entries.text: Poison Damage added to your attacks.

entries.label: Cold Skill Damage
entries.text: Increases the damage of your Cold skills. This stat is calculated on top of the final value.

entries.label: Fire Skill Damage
entries.text: Increases the damage of your Fire skills. This stat is calculated on top of the final value.

entries.label: Lightning Skill Damage
entries.text: Increases the damage of your Lightning skills. This stat is calculated on top of the final value.

entries.label: Arcane Skill Damage
entries.text: Increases the damage of your Arcane skills. This stat is calculated on top of the final value.

entries.label: Poison Skill Damage
entries.text: Increases the damage of your Poison skills. This stat is calculated on top of the final value.

entries.label: Ignore Cold Resistance
entries.text: The amount of enemy Cold resistance ignored when dealing Cold Damage.

entries.label: Ignore Fire Resistance
entries.text: The amount of enemy Fire resistance ignored when dealing Fire Damage.

entries.label: Ignore Lightning Resistance
entries.text: The amount of enemy Lightning resistance ignored when dealing Lightning Damage.

entries.label: Ignore Arcane Resistance
entries.text: The amount of enemy Arcane resistance ignored when dealing Arcane Damage.

entries.label: Ignore Poison Resistance
entries.text: The amount of enemy Poison resistance ignored when dealing Poison Damage.

entries.label: Defense
entries.text: Defense lowers the chance of enemies hitting you with Physical Attacks or Projectiles.

entries.label: Chance to Block attacks
entries.text: The chance to block incoming attacks and projectiles.

entries.label: Dodge Chance
entries.text: The chance to dodge incoming attacks and projectiles.

entries.label: Chance to suppress incoming spell hits
entries.text: Chance on spell hit to mitigate 50% of the incoming damage.

entries.label: Physical damage reduction
entries.text: Reduces incoming Physical Damage

entries.label: Magic damage reduction
entries.text: Reduces incoming Magic Damage such as Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison and Arcane

entries.label: Damage reduced
entries.text: Reduces a flat amount of damage from every source. This stat is additive and does not scale from anything.

entries.label: Damage Return
entries.text: Amount of damage returned to the attacker.

entries.label: Faster Hit Recovery
entries.text: Increases the speed of recovery after being hit by an attack or projectile.

entries.label: All Resistances
entries.text: Increases your resistance against damage from All Elements.

entries.label: Cold Resistance
entries.text: Increases your resistance to Cold damage.

entries.label: Fire Resistance
entries.text: Increases your resistance to Fire damage.

entries.label: Lightning Resistance
entries.text: Increases your resistance to Lightning damage.

entries.label: to Arcane Resistance
entries.text: Increases your resistance to Arcane damage.

entries.label: Poison Resistance
entries.text: Increases your resistance to Poison damage.

entries.label: Cold Absorption
entries.text: Absorbs a portion of all incoming Cold Damage as healing.

entries.label: Fire Absorption
entries.text: Absorbs a portion of all incoming Fire Damage as healing.

entries.label: Lightning Absorption
entries.text: Absorbs a portion of all incoming Lightning Damage as healing.

entries.label: Arcane Absorption
entries.text: Absorbs a portion of all incoming Arcane Damage as healing.

entries.label: Poison Absorption
entries.text: Absorbs a portion of all incoming Poison Damage as healing.

entries.label: Poison Length Reduced
entries.text: Lowered poison debuff duration.

entries.label: to Life
entries.text: Your Maximum Life.

entries.label: to Mana
entries.text: Your Maximum Mana.

entries.label: Life Replenish
entries.text: Amount of Life replenished each second.

entries.label: Mana Replenish
entries.text: Amount of Mana replenished each second.

entries.label: Life stolen per Hit
entries.text: Amount of Life replenished when striking an enemy.

entries.label: Mana stolen per Hit
entries.text: Amount of Mana replenished when striking an enemy.

entries.label: Life After Kill
entries.text: Amount of Life replenished after killing a monster.

entries.label: Mana After Kill
entries.text: Amount of Mana replenished after killing a monster.

entries.label: Skill Haste
entries.text: Increases cooldown recovery rate.

entries.label: Flask Skill Haste
entries.text: Increases Flask cooldown recovery rate.

entries.label: Increased life replenish while a flask effect is active
entries.text: Amount of increased life regeneration from potions.

entries.label: Portion of incoming damage mitigated while a flask effect is active
entries.text: Amount of damage taken reduced when regenerating from a potion.

entries.label: Movement Speed
entries.text: Amount of increased Movement Speed.

entries.label: Jumping Power
entries.text: Increases how far you can jump.

entries.label: Light Radius
entries.text: Effects your visibility range and base movement speed scaling.

entries.label: Experience Gain Increased by
entries.text: Increases your experience gained from killing monsters.

entries.label: Magic Find
entries.text: Increased chance of finding magic items. (Mercenary’s Magic Find is added to player Magic Find on kills).

entries.label: Extra Gold from kills
entries.text: Extra gold dropped from monsters when killed.

entries.label: Merchant prices
entries.text: Discounted prices when buying from the Merchant.

entries.label: Mining
entries.text: Your Mining skill level.

entries.label: Jewelcrafting
entries.text: Your Jewelcrafting skill level.

entries.label: Herbalism
entries.text: Your Herbalism skill level.
